extraction_attempt.error: ValueError: emitter offsets do not place the measured start in the measured segment (benchmarks/peak_slice.py:214)
extraction_attempt.root_cause: emitter_offsets (peak_slice.py:122) labels segments from the first physically-offered row (anchor_ms), and label_segment (peak_slice.py:136) then requires anchor_ms <= measured_start_ms. With the 120 s pre-roll override the first physical row in the narrower window falls after the measured start (capture order is non-monotonic, so the first physical row is not the earliest stamp), so the pre-roll cannot be represented and the extractor refuses to emit a mislabeled slice.

decision: Do not start the scored run. While the foreign project ran, the idle-host rule forbade starting a second Kafka/Flink stack. The host only freed at ~18:02:30Z (T+20.8 min); slice extraction then took ~5.6 min and failed closed, and a ~13-min warm 1x run could not fit the ~12 min remaining. No measurement was taken and no stack was started.
